rationale: The bid-ask spread of 106.7 bps is extremely wide, creating an immediate structural disadvantage that makes any intraday entry costly to overcome. Price is already 5.54% gapped up and sitting at 69.8% of today's range with only two candles of data, offering no clean technical level to anchor a thesis with confidence. The combination of wide spread, early session illiquidity (161K shares traded), and a stock already extended from its prior close argues for waiting until price action and liquidity develop further before committing capital.
